title: Yun Shan and Protector Wu
summary: Xiao Yan boosts himself with the Luminous Jadeite Change and fights Yun Shan with Superimposed Wings and the Octane Blast, landing the first hit Yun Shan has taken since becoming a Dou Zong. Yun Shan still overpowers him, until Yao Lao appears and turns the fight. Yun Shan calls out Protector Wu of the Hall of Souls, who has been hidden in the sect and who once helped Han Feng against Yao Lao. Protector Wu fights Yao Lao with a Triple Soul Lock and says the Hall of Souls wants something from the Xiao Clan alive. Xiao Yan guesses they want the jade of Tuo She Gu Di. Alone against Yun Shan, Xiao Yan uses the Open Mountain Seal and his Glaze Lotus Core Flame, and Yao Lao passes him the Bone Chilling Flame hidden in his ring. Xiao Yan then unleashes the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.
